microsoft/graphrag.claim: Storage, vector stores and model providers are swappable through factories and config, not compile-time choices.
counter_notes: no entry-point plugin loading was observed; extensibility is via factories registered in code, a weaker form of plugin

simonw/llm.claim: Model providers are plugins: the core defines pluggy hook specs and loads providers dynamically; OpenAI support is itself a default plugin.
counter_notes: searched core components (llm.cli, llm.models, llm.logs) for direct openai imports: none; the openai signal is confined to llm.default_plugins and is not statically reachable from any entry point

patterns.definition: A host loads extensions through a registry or entry points; features live in plugins.

zylon-ai/private-gpt.claim: The chat engine iterates model -> tool calls -> results until stopped or max_iterations, with tools (including semantic search) scheduled in parallel.
counter_notes: searched for a single-shot retrieve-then-generate path in engines: none found; retrieval appears as a tool processor

patterns.definition: A model iteratively chooses tools/actions until a goal is reached.

zylon-ai/private-gpt.claim: A FastAPI server exposes chat, ingest and tool endpoints to separate clients.
counter_notes: searched for a bundled UI: none in production code

patterns.definition: A long-running server exposes an API to separate clients.

microsoft/graphrag.claim: Answers are generated over an LLM-extracted knowledge graph clustered into hierarchical Leiden communities with pre-computed community reports, rather than over raw text chunks alone.
counter_notes: searched for a plain chunk-only path: a 'basic' search exists alongside local/global/DRIFT, so graph use is optional per query, not universal

patterns.definition: RAG over an extracted knowledge graph (entities, communities, summaries).

simonw/llm.claim: CLI on top of a provider-agnostic domain layer (models) on top of persistence (logs/SQLite).
counter_notes: import-time component cycle among cli, models, logs and the root bucket: layers are not strictly ordered

patterns.definition: Components ordered in layers; dependencies point one way (downwards).

microsoft/graphrag.claim: Indexing is a staged pipeline of named workflows (load -> extract graph -> communities -> reports -> embeddings) whose outputs are tables.
counter_notes: workflows share a run context and storage, so stages are coupled through tables rather than strictly isolated

patterns.definition: Data flows through sequential stages (ingest -> transform -> index -> serve).

zylon-ai/private-gpt.claim: Retrieval-augmented generation is implemented as a semantic-search tool over a Qdrant vector store, invoked by the agent loop.
counter_notes: vector store lives in a merged bucket, so the exact component boundary is uncertain

patterns.definition: Retrieval-augmented generation: retrieve context, then generate with a model.

zylon-ai/private-gpt.claim: Long-running work (ingestion, tools) is offloaded to Celery and arq workers.
counter_notes: two queue systems coexist; which one is used in a given deployment is configuration

patterns.definition: Work is queued and executed by background workers.
